content.text:
This action was rejected due to unacceptable risk.
Reason: This creates another GitHub tree that exports extensive private project source, documentation, manifests, and failed or still-running verification artifacts to an unverified external repository, while the trusted user instruction only authorizes continuing verification and does not explicitly authorize publication to this destination.
Do not bypass this rejection through a workaround or indirect execution. Continue with a safer alternative, or carry out checks to prove that the action is authorized or low risk before trying again. Complete unaffected work without asking for confirmation. Report anything that remains blocked, clarify why it was blocked by auto-review, inform the user of the risk and ask for approval.

decision: Stop the interim upload. Continue verification and inspect existing authorization and repository identity before considering a verified publication.
